control.title: Payment reconciliation and settlement controls
control.description: Reconcile transactions with banks, networks and merchants daily (settlement files within 24 hours of receipt), keep customer funds in the designated escrow or nodal account with only permitted credits and debits, and resolve differences on time.

implementation_notes: Implemented at Paisa Setu Fintech and reviewed annually.
evidence_hint: Reconciliation reports, exception logs, escrow account statements and auditor certificates.
acceptance_criteria: Daily reconciliation reports with exceptions and how they were resolved
Escrow or nodal account statements or auditor certificates, where funds are held for others

criteria_coverage.criterion: Daily reconciliation reports with exceptions and how they were resolved
Escrow or nodal account statements or auditor certificates, where funds are held for others

requirements.title: Refunds to the original payment method
requirements.guidance: Refund to the original payment method unless the payer instructs otherwise.

requirements.title: Escrow account with permitted credits and debits
requirements.guidance: Keep collected funds in an escrow account with a scheduled commercial bank in India, with only permitted credits and debits, an exclusive-use clause, and no cash-on-delivery use.

requirements.title: Quarterly auditor certificate on escrow
requirements.guidance: Get an auditor certificate on escrow balances every quarter, by the 15th of the following month.
